value.rationale: The ecology-inspired product-Monod proxy has two truly independently placeable essential substrates. It exhibits forced co-location and a nontrivial exact 1-to-n active-hotspot staircase with a sharp analytic scale. By contrast a single Monod resource strictly prefers uniform allocation for every supply level. This gives a complete, interpretable benchmark for nutrient co-limitation versus saturation; not a trivial normalization or arbitrary slice. Consequences remain restricted to the static idealized model.
